title: Tests cover helpers directly, not the HTTP handler end-to-end
evidence: test_server.c:5-44 exercises parse_fields, raw SQLite CRUD and serialize_book but never calls handler() or hits a route; the request dispatch/body-accumulation path (server.c:39-52) is untested
suggestion: Add an integration test that starts the daemon (or calls handler) and asserts status codes for POST/GET/PUT/DELETE/404

title: Fixed 4096/20000-byte stack buffers truncate long fields silently
evidence: server.c:38 serialize_book uses char title/author/isbn[4096] and callers pass char[20000]; a title/author longer than the buffer is truncated by snprintf with no error
suggestion: Size the serialized buffer from the row lengths, or report an error on overflow

title: Unchecked realloc in GET /books list builder
evidence: server.c:44 `out=realloc(out,cap)` result is not checked for NULL; on allocation failure this leaks the old buffer and dereferences NULL in the following memcpy
suggestion: Check realloc return into a temp and fail with 500 on NULL
